title: Meter Services Standard — Leak Adjustment History and the Estimated Water Read, Utility Pass-Through Service
content:
**Standard.** When an estimated water read is set on a Utility Pass-Through Service account, a leak adjustment credit posted on the account bears on the estimate. Where a leak adjustment credit was posted on the account in the last four months, the reads behind the estimate still carry leaked water and the estimate is set at 80 percent; where no leak adjustment credit was posted in the last four months but one was posted in the last twelve months, the estimate is set at 95 percent; an account with no leak adjustment credit posted in the last twelve months takes no leak share in the estimate.

**Counting.** A leak adjustment credit is dated by the day it was posted. It was posted in the last four months when fewer than 4 whole months separate that date from the handling date, and in the last twelve months when fewer than 12 whole months do. The share multiplies the estimated consumption as converted to the cycle, before the final figure is rounded.

## Tiers

| Latest leak adjustment credit posted | Whole months to the handling date | Estimate set at |
|---|---|---|
| In the last 4 months | 0 to 3 | 80 percent |
| Not in the last 4 months, but in the last 12 months | 4 to 11 | 95 percent |
| Not in the last 12 months, or never | 12 or more | no leak share |

## Boundary dates (handling date 10 June, hypothetical)

| Leak adjustment credit posted | Whole months | Estimate set at |
|---|---|---|
| 11 February | 3 | 80 percent |
| 10 February | 4 | 95 percent |
| 11 June of the previous year | 11 | 95 percent |
| 10 June of the previous year | 12 | no leak share |

**Worked figure (hypothetical).** Converted figure 6.10 kgal with a leak adjustment credit posted 2 months ago: 6.10 times 80 percent is 4.88 kgal.
